title: Owner-confirmed seasonal flight reconciliation with isolated group rules

expectation.example: Owner clarifies positionRules flight names are current-season flights; shared template library intentionally retains previous-season flights. Owner selects most recently adjusted A or B as source and explicitly handles new, renamed or retired differences.
expectation.expected: Season candidates exactly follow normalized job flight names; library spare templates retained without missing-job alarms. Compare A/B seasons in either direction, keep group job/qualification independence. Explicit new confirmation waits for target job setup; rename preserves target jobs and updates scoped references and current time; retire removes target current flight/jobs/scoped rules, retains historical records/frequency ledgers/other group/library. Offline preparation and online suggestions share current-season projection. Owner verified resulting UI list, library, direction and retirement option.
expectation.unchanged: Solver safety/fairness/qualifications, historical facts, other group configurations, shared library/weekly plan on target mapping, explicit shared-template edit contracts, current-group-only configuration export retained. No whole A/B backup.
expectation.fallback: No automatic mapping or deletion. Cancel, changed source-season list, stale template/current time or duplicate target refuse whole action. New confirmations do not invent jobs or qualifications and remain pending until jobs configured. Spare templates and historical/frequency ledgers not removed on retirement; pending differences persist after refresh. Missing source template/time requires completion instead of invented time.

reproduction.reason: Four observed failure classes are retained: missing review, missing retirement, spare library mistaken for season, online spare admission.

answers.originalFailure: See retained red reminder/retire/spare-season/online tests and final focused/verify evidence. The original catalogue-based comparison has been replaced following owner clarification by independent actual-job season sets.
answers.laterChanges: Group projection, storage restoration, configuration import, seasonal candidates and online batch additions can regress results; source fingerprint guards, all-reference isolation tests, repeated switch/reload, XLSX byte reimport and online submit-season filtering cover them.
answers.finalArtifact: Owner final page confirmation plus source-hashed real-workbook roundtrip and independent set counts demonstrate displayed scope and data persistence. Real owner-data mapping/retirement remains unverified and recorded as such.

review.missedScope: Initial design treated all library templates as active flights and missed retired old flights. Owner clarified seasonal membership; reviewed weekly/daily pickers, all three preparation entries and online batch additions. Library-only flights no longer warn or enter season. Real action on owner data remains unverified.
review.rootCause: The original requirement discussion conflated reusable template library and current-season membership. Current-season fact must be actual job flight names; A/B isolated rules require explicit source-group choice. Separate consumer paths had still admitted full-library flights.
review.earlyDetection: Before future seasonal or import edits, independently count actual job-flight names and compare with spare library, trace all candidate-producing and final write paths, then fail a spare-template admission test and both-direction set-difference test. Retain XLSX byte/reload and historical-ledger invariants; request only actual page evidence within owner authorization.
